sn41.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Godatto Macchikāsaṇḍe viharati Ambāṭakavane || || 2
sn41.7:1.2: Atha kho Citto gahapati yenāyasmā Godatto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Godattam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Cittaṃ gahapatim āyasmā Godatto etad avoca || ||
sn41.7:1.3: Yā cāyaṃ gahapati appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti yā ca suññatācetovimutti yā ca animittā cetovimutti ime dhammā nānatthā nānavyañjanā udāhu ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti || || 4
sn41.7:1.4: Atthi bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānavyañjanā ca || ||
sn41.7:1.5: Atthi pana bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhamme ekatthā ceva vyañjanam eva nānan ti || 4
sn41.7:2.1: Katamo ca pana bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānavyañjanā ca || || 5
sn41.7:2.2: Idha bhante bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharati || tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ || tathā catuttham iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena avereṇa avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati ||
sn41.7:2.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharati || tathā dutiyam tathā tatiyam tathā catuttham iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbatthatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati || ||
sn41.7:2.6: Ayaṃ vuccati bhante appamāṇena cetasā vimutti || || 6
sn41.7:3.2: Idha bhante bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja viharati || ||
sn41.7:4.2: Idha bhante bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti patisañcikkhati ||
sn41.7:4.3: Suññam idam attena vā attaniyena vā ti ||
sn41.7:5.2: Idha bhante bhikkhu sabbanimittānam amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhim upasampajja viharati ||
sn41.7:5.4: Ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā nānavyañjanā ca || || 10
sn41.7:6.1: Katamo ca bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānaṃ || || 11
sn41.7:6.2: Rāgo bhante pamāṇakaraṇo doso pamāṇakaraṇo moho pamāṇakarano ||
sn41.7:6.3: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anubhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā || ||
sn41.7:6.4: Yāvatā kho bhante appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam akkhāyati ||
sn41.7:6.5: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena || suññā dosena || suññā mohena || || 12
sn41.7:6.6: Rāgo bhante kiñcanaṃ doso kiñcanam moho kiñcanam ||
sn41.7:6.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchimamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā || ||
sn41.7:6.8: Yāvatā kho bhante ākiñcaññā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam akkhāyati ||
sn41.7:6.9: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena || || 13
sn41.7:6.10: Rāgo kho bhante nimittakaraṇo doso nimittakaraṇo moho nimittakaraṇo ||
sn41.7:6.11: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā || ||
sn41.7:6.12: Yāvatā kho bhante animittā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsam cetovimutti aggam akkhāyati ||
sn41.7:6.13: sā kho pana akuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena || || 14
sn41.7:6.14: Ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yam pariyāyam āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti || || 2
